newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 19.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- West African countries meet in Ivory Coast's capital Yamoussoukro to discuss common strategy in fight against a surge in crime.
- President Henri Konan Bedie says in statement Ivorians who seek political asylum abroad have no reason to do so as everyone in Ivory Coast is equal before the law
- Ivorian sack maker FILTISAC holds annual general meeting on March 26 in commercial capital Abidjan
- Timid response in Abidjan to 72-hour strike call by secondary school teachers union SYNESCI over pay and conditions but more widely followed in inland centres.

- Farm sector has only limited access to credit, participants at "open day" debates on Ivory Coast's financial sector hear - Management threatens to lay off staff representatives at strike bound Franco-Ivorian ship building and repair yard CARENA
